settings.title: Site settings
settings.meta: Name, languages and which pages to show
settings.pagesNote: A page you turn off takes its orbit on the home page with it, and readers lose the way in. The content stays; turn it back on and it's there.
settings.descriptionsNote: The description each page shows in search results and on share cards, plus the opening line of the "About" menu. Leave a box empty to use the generic line shown faintly inside it. One language at a time; languages you skip use the generic line too.
settings.confirmDesc: The default language goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Addresses without a prefix (like {{host}}/blog) will show {{to}}, so {{from}} links you've already shared will open in {{to}}; {{from}} moves under /{{fromPrefix}}/. Addresses starting with /{{toPrefix}}/ will redirect to the same page without the prefix. Search engines will take a while to catch up.
settings.notifyNote: Get a webhook message when someone comments or asks for a friend link. When you reply to a comment, readers who ticked the box get an email.

lang.warn: Changing the default language after launch changes every address on the site: links you've already shared without a prefix will open in the new default language.
lang.single: With only one language on, the site shows no language menu.

identity.name: Site name
identity.author: Author
identity.authorHint: leave empty to use the site name
identity.shareCard: What a shared link looks like
identity.launchPadHint: where you are: the log's rocket lifts off here, and it's the amber dot on the Collection globe. A rough city is enough; only one decimal place is kept
identity.locateFailed: Couldn't get your location (no browser permission, or the site isn't on https). Typing the coordinates works just as well
identity.signatureNone: No signature; nothing appears at the end of posts.
identity.signatureHint: At the end of every post, a small point of light writes it out stroke by stroke. Each <path> in the file is a stroke and each <circle> a dot, written in file order; single-line strokes (not filled outlines) look the most like handwriting.
identity.signatureUnusable: Couldn't find any strokes in this file: it needs a viewBox and at least one <path>.

errors.nameRequired: The site name can't be empty
errors.nameTooLong: The site name can be at most {{max}} characters
errors.authorTooLong: The author name can be at most {{max}} characters
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most {{max}} characters
errors.email: That email address doesn't look right
errors.github: A GitHub username only has letters, digits and hyphens, up to 39 characters
errors.launchPad: Latitude must be between -{{max}} and {{max}}, longitude between -180 and 180

theme.label: Default body
theme.note: What first-time readers see: the body on the home page, the site's colors and the share images all follow it. Readers who pick one in the top bar keep their own choice.
theme.readerSwitchOn: On: readers can switch from the top bar, and their choice is kept in their browser
theme.readerSwitchOff: Off: everyone sees the one you chose; the body in the top bar is shown but not clickable

pages.alwaysOn: Notes and About are always there.
pages.groupOrbitNote: One you turn off leaves the home page orbits and the top bar. Notes and About are always there.
pages.groupAboutNote: The pages under "About" in the top bar.
pages.groupMoreNote: The pages under "More" in the top bar.

desc.moments: Short notes, a line at a time
desc.works: Things you've made, each on a timeline
desc.setup: Hand-drawn sheets, or the built-in ones
desc.log: Milestones from one year to now
desc.photos: Needs a NAS or an uploaded folder
desc.friends: Other people's sites and a request form
desc.colophon: How this site is made, with a Q&A

sky.note: Each step adds something here: the owner, the languages, the name, the orbits. What you end up with is what readers see when they open the home page.

notify.optional: optional, leave empty to turn off
notify.formats: Discord and Slack URLs get their own format; any other URL (ntfy, n8n, your own service) gets JSON with event, text and data. Readers' emails and IPs are never included.
notify.mailReady: Reply emails: ready (using the newsletter's Resend settings). When a reader ticks “Email me when the author replies”, your reply is emailed to them.
notify.mailOff: Reply emails: off, RESEND_API_KEY and NEWSLETTER_FROM aren't set. Once they are, readers who ticked the box get an email when you reply.

backup.head: Backup and moving
backup.note: Download a copy of the current database (posts, comments, settings and collection history are all in it), for moving or safekeeping. Uploaded images and photos aren't in the database; copy the uploads and gallery folders on the host separately. The host also backs up to ./backups every day.
backup.restarting: Got it. The backend is restarting with this backup; the page will reload when it is back…
backup.confirmTitle: Replace the whole site with this backup?
backup.confirmBody: "{{name}}" will replace every post, comment and setting. The current database is not deleted: it stays next to the database on the host (db.sqlite.before-restore-…) if you need it back.
